clients.name: Bump Digital
clients.context:
Bump Digital is the agency Kelsey contracts with; she runs Meta (and proposed LinkedIn) ads for their client Plumbline. KAM contact: Josh Blackman, josh.blackman@bumpdigital.co.nz, 021 840 017.

PLUMBLINE (end client): Bathware/tapware brand, NZ + AU. plumbline.co.nz. Contact: Lauren Rogers, Lauren.rogers@plumbline.co.nz. Existing Google Ads advertiser. New catalogue launches annually (seasonality factor).

BRAND: Pillars = Design, Quality, Choice. B2B pitch (specifiers/architects): design-led product backed by technical resources (3D files, renders, compliance) that keeps projects moving instead of stalling at spec stage. B2C pitch (homeowners): quality bathware that's already resolved (finish, function, durability). Credibility: Lead Free Tapware, Designed in NZ, Manufactured in NZ, Toitu Certified, most complete architectural bathware collection. Competitors: Robertsons Bathware, Elementi, ABI Interiors, Astra Walker, Newtech Bathroomware, Caroma, Duravit, Methven, St Michel Bathroomware, Nero, Bath Co. Full brand guidelines held by Lauren, share on request.

META ADS - CURRENT STATE (Bump Digital's review): 7 campaigns live at $150/day; only 'Book a Consultation - Melbourne' ($50/day) is actionable/lead-generating. The other $100/day (2/3 of spend) is pure brand awareness with no measurable objective - the core inefficiency flagged.

META ADS - PROPOSED GROWTH PLAN: Restructure to $140/day, 100% actionable, across 5 locations (Melbourne/Auckland/Wellington showrooms + NZ & AU national), split B2B (trade/specifiers) vs B2C (homeowners). Showroom 'Book a Consultation' campaigns: $20/day each x3 = $60/day. National product/catalogue campaigns (ecommerce + lead capture): NZ $40/day + AU $40/day = $80/day. Creative needed: Auckland + Wellington showroom graphics, catalogue graphics x8, optional showroom video walkthroughs. Management scope: 7 hrs one-time setup, then 7 hrs/month ongoing (5 management, 1 creative brief, 1 reporting).

LINKEDIN - PROPOSED LAUNCH (new channel, B2B/specifiers): Reuse showroom creative + text-only ads. $60/day (~$1,800/month): 3x consultation campaigns ($10/day each - Melbourne/Wellington/Auckland) + 2x catalogue campaigns ($15/day each - NZ/AU). Setup 6 hrs, then 6 hrs/month ongoing (3 management, 2 creative, 1 reporting).

COMBINED (Meta+LinkedIn): 26 hrs first month with setup, 13 hrs every month after.

CONVERSIONS THAT COUNT: showroom visits, phone calls, ecommerce sales, retail sales, in-person presentations, A&D spec/CAD/sample requests, catalogue requests, quote requests, EDM sign-ups.

EMAIL MARKETING: Not in Bump Digital's initial scope, but Plumbline said yes to wanting help with it (esp. driving ecommerce sales) - a flagged upsell opportunity.

PLUMBLINE'S OWN FY27 MARKETING PLAN (background, not Kelsey's scope): Theme 'Demanding Outcomes'. Audiences: Specifiers (hero focus, 'Win The Specifier'), Homeowners (affluent/designer-led), Retailers (opportunistic). Big projects: Future Website, Catalogue 26/27, AU Market Expansion, Strong Brand in Retail, Lead-Focused Marketing, Product Configurator. Total FY27 media budget: NZ $284K + AU $126K = $410K NZD, across Digital/Social, Print & Editorial, and Partnerships & Events. Plumbline's NZ budget includes a line for 'Bump Digital / Admin - digital management & production fees' at $8,400/yr.

BRAND GUIDELINES (Plumbline, V02): Purpose - 'Enrich the human experience'. Mission - 'To create products and moments of beauty that move you, inspire you, and feel exactly as they should'. Values - World-class, Trusted, Forward-thinking, Customer-focused, Passionate. Brand character - 'the conscious creator', natural integrity + positive agency.

LOGO: Wordmark 'PLUMBLINE' (bold sans, all caps). Secondary lockup adds 'ARCHITECTURAL BATHWARE' beneath. Monogram is a 'ripple' chevron/wave mark, used for constrained formats (favicons, social avatars) and sign-off moments - never as a replacement for the wordmark where space allows.

TYPOGRAPHY: Primary = Material Serif (custom serif, headlines/statement copy/CTAs) - e.g. 'Sanctuary found', 'GET INSPIRED AT PLUMBLINE.CO.NZ'. Secondary = RM Neue (sans-serif) for body copy, sub-headings (often tracked-out caps, e.g. 'POLISHED ORGANIC BRASS FINISH') and annotations.

TONE OF VOICE: Emotive, rhythmic, calm - short evocative phrase triplets separated by the ripple glyph, e.g. 'Sensation on skin > Rewiring something deeper > Your sanctuary' or 'The sleep from your eyes > The fog of old dreams washed clean > Anew for the day'. Used sparingly, with generous spacing - good reference for ad headline/caption structure.

COLOUR PALETTE (hex): Ripple Blue (hero, optimistic/calming) #CDD7DC. Moss (grounding, dark) #233528. Sand (light, warm) #F5F0E6. Clay (warm, dark) #503732. Rule: never pair two light or two dark colours together - always one light + one dark for contrast.

IMAGERY STYLE: Four buckets - (1) Product: 'collection-led' (raw/elemental macro shots of metal + water) and 'product-led' (realistic, soft dappled natural lighting, product in its real setting, not flashy); (2) Place & Space: sanctuary + rejuvenation, warm light, dynamic water always present; (3) Connected Elements: NZ landscapes/water/mountains, supports the elemental world; (4) Plumbline World: behind-the-scenes craftsmanship/team, natural light, realism. Overall feel: warm, elemental, unpretentious sophistication - avoid anything slick/corporate/artificial.

RELEVANCE FOR AD CREATIVE: Match this palette and tone in any Meta/LinkedIn creative for Plumbline - warm natural lighting, close-up material/product detail or genuine lifestyle moments (not stock-photo-clean), Material Serif for any on-image headline, ripple glyph as a small brand device, never two light or two dark colours side by side.

(Sourced from docs Kelsey shared directly in chat on 2026-09-07: Bump Digital onboarding brief, Bump Digital's Plumbline Meta/LinkedIn proposal, Plumbline's FY27 marketing plans (Overall + Australia), and Plumbline's full Brand Guidelines V02 (283pp). Full documents are not in this export - ask Kelsey if anything beyond this summary is needed.)
